name: Travel Agent
description: Desktop travel assistant that researches and books trips in a built-in browser and stops before payment.
whatItDoes: Plans trips, compares flights and hotels on real booking sites, fills forms and brings the user to the payment page to finish themselves.
howItWorks: A desktop app places a chat next to a controlled browser that the agent operates, with a companion Chrome extension. The user adds a model provider key in the app, and the workflow requires explicit selection before any booking step.

requirements.name: Node.js and pnpm
requirements.description: Node.js 24+ and pnpm 11 for running from source

requirements.name: Model provider API key
requirements.description: For example Anthropic or DeepSeek, added in the Models screen

models: Bring-your-own provider key (Anthropic, DeepSeek and others)
